## Release

Tick exactly one. The next release (run by hand) bumps the version by the biggest box ticked since the last one.

- [ ] major: breaks saves or settings, or a big milestone
- [ ] minor: a new feature or setting
- [ ] patch: fixes and speedups
- [ ] none: docs, CI, refactors; no release
